title: Mesh datamodel and validation helpers
objective: Create benchmark-local mesh dataclasses and validation helpers for Phase 10 prerequisite meshes without adding solver or material behavior.

plan_assets.asset_description: Phase E1 shared mesh utilities scope and acceptance criteria.

scope: Add benchmark-local mesh dataclasses for coordinates, connectivity, boundary node sets, and face tags.
Add positive Jacobian/orientation validation helpers for supported element families.
Keep the surface solver-agnostic and independent from existing benchmark runners.
implementation_steps: Run GitNexus impact before editing any existing helper symbols.
Add the internal mesh datamodel in a new benchmark-local module.
Add validation helpers for element connectivity shape, deterministic boundary labels, and positive Jacobians.
Add focused unit tests for dataclass invariants and validation failure cases.
Run targeted tests, ruff, mypy, and GitNexus detect_changes before commit.
deliverables: Unit tests for mesh datamodel and validation helpers.
Updated phase gate history after execution.
acceptance_criteria: Mesh dataclasses are importable without importing solvers or materials.
Validation detects invalid connectivity shape and non-positive Jacobians.
No existing benchmark runner behavior changes.
risks: Shared mesh helpers may grow into a hidden solver abstraction; mitigate by keeping Phase 1 geometry-only.
completion_notes: Added benchmark-local `BenchmarkMesh` datamodel and validation helpers in `_meshes.py`.
Gate C evidence: `uv run pytest packages/mechdsl-core/tests/test_phase10_mesh_utils.py -v` -> 10/10 passed; ruff and mypy clean for touched Phase 1 Python files.
GitHub issue updates were skipped because `gh auth status` reported an invalid token.
